posters.title: One Google identity provider
posters.detail: Shared provider covers FabinGurung public repositories on main; private Sheets still require explicit access and finance-capable accounts stay repo-scoped.
posters.label: Inspect source governance

posters.title: Five originals. One folder.
posters.takeaway: Never fork the source of truth.
posters.detail: Original source/template Google Sheets retain their LIVE IDs in the centralized Drive folder; versioned GitHub data is only a public projection.
posters.label: Open the source directory

posters.title: LIVE source fetch now works.
posters.detail: The verified publishing path read Finance live, published 27 vendors and 74 payment entries, and independently checked all 32 indicative Amrit rates.
posters.label: Finance dashboard

posters.title: Never price empty measurements.
posters.detail: 26 reusable measurement methods exist, but Amrit has no approved quantities, BOQ or AOC. Preserve the HOLD until CAD and field evidence are accepted.
posters.label: Measurement workflow

posters.title: Drawings become verified numbers.
posters.detail: The next engineering step is to connect source drawing IDs and site evidence to per-element quantities, then group approved items without inventing totals.
posters.label: Where quantities start

posters.title: An Action success needs source proof.
posters.takeaway: Verify unattended jobs and responsive pages.
posters.detail: A Pages deploy can be green without a LIVE Sheet read. Verify source-specific logs and inspect the released UI on real desktop and mobile browsers.
posters.label: Publication checks

posters.title: The Sheet is the working source
posters.takeaway: Edit the source. Publish a verified view.
posters.detail: Google Sheets remains the place for payment entry and correction. The website displays a versioned snapshot.
posters.label: Finance overview

posters.title: Rohini is not Fishtail
posters.takeaway: Keep every company's records in its own lane.
posters.detail: Shared website design does not imply shared accounts, totals or ownership.
posters.label: Company finance

posters.title: Three recorded columns
posters.detail: These figures are displayed separately. No unapproved net amount is inferred from them.
posters.label: Payment dashboard

posters.title: Respect the calendar
posters.takeaway: BS and AD dates remain distinct.
posters.detail: Nepali and Gregorian dates must not be mixed into a single timeline without a verified conversion.
posters.label: Payment dashboard

posters.title: Follow the vendor trail
posters.detail: The human-readable vendor sections and their payment rows stay traceable to the source register.
posters.label: Explore vendors

posters.title: Reconcile before release
posters.detail: A changed source becomes a new public snapshot only after checks pass. The last verified release stays available otherwise.
posters.label: Published figures

posters.title: Four rate families
posters.detail: Each rate collection retains its own provenance, date, scope and source documents.
posters.label: Rate collections

posters.title: Units before comparison
posters.takeaway: Same unit. Same scope. Same basis.
posters.detail: A rate without a matching unit, location, time and inclusions is not automatically comparable.
posters.label: Rate comparison

posters.title: Capture is not payment
posters.takeaway: A field note needs review before finance use.
posters.detail: Unverified site submissions, attendance and material movements must not silently become expense records.
posters.label: Field guide

posters.title: Attendance is its own record
posters.takeaway: Presence does not equal an expense.
posters.detail: Attendance-only workbooks are separate from money and goods ledgers.
posters.label: Field records

posters.title: One site, distinct departments
posters.takeaway: One design system. Separate source domains.
posters.detail: Rates, payments and reference posters share navigation while keeping their own records and checks.
posters.label: System map

posters.title: Improve the view first
posters.detail: Readable public pages and repeatable release checks come before replacing the existing entry workflow.
posters.label: Site overview
